overview.name: Invesco Core Fixed Income ETF
overview.description: The fund is an actively managed ETF that seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing, under normal market conditions, at least 80% of its net assets, plus borrowings for investment purposes, in investment-grade fixed-income securities,and in derivatives and other instruments that have economic characteristics similar to such securities. The fund is non-diversified.
